hook.h2: He asked for his name, and then gave him a better one
hook.text: He said, "You will no longer be named Jacob, but Israel, for you have struggled with me and with men, and won."
father: "You will no longer be named Jacob, but Israel, for you have struggled with me and with men, and won."
hook.note: Jacob had spent his life taking what he wanted by hand — the birthright, the blessing, the flocks — and the name he was given at birth said so. He wrestled all night and would not let go without a blessing, and what he got was a new name and a limp he kept. In this Bible the naming is printed in BLUE, because our Father said it. A man can be told what he is supposed to be by a great many voices; only one of them can rename him.

short350: You have wanted a Father your whole life. Not a doctrine about Him. Not a distant power. A Father — His voice, His heart turned toward you.
Father's Heart Bible is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking.
Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's in RED. The Spirit's in PURPLE.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, words He never spoke are never colored, and narration stays black.
Jacob wrestled all night and would not let go without a blessing. Our Father asked him his name, and then gave him a better one. He walked away marked, blessed, and known.
That is what this Bible was made to do. Not to tell you about a Father who speaks, but to show you where He already has.

He is not distant. He is not disappointed. He is your Heavenly Father, and He delights in you as His beloved son. If father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you: the Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood, but the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

An introduction opens each book, a Father's note closes each with a short prayer, and 1,354 notes serve the reader, not the scholar. A presentation page carries their name. Six by nine, hardcover, full color throughout.
A fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek — complete, 66 books and 31,085 verses. A gift, a keepsake, an heirloom.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

faq.q: What makes the Men's Bible different from the other editions?
faq.a: It is the complete Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color — every book, every page, nothing abridged — in a cover made for a man, opening with pages written for him: you have been told what a man is supposed to be, and your Father tells you whose you are. Passages on intimacy, identity and inheritance for men follow. From Genesis 1:1 on, it is the same Bible every other edition carries.

faq.q: Is this a men's study Bible with a curriculum?
faq.a: It is the Bible itself, not a program. There are no lesson plans, discussion guides or dated readings. What runs through it is an introduction to each of the 66 books, a Father's note and short prayer closing each one, and 1,354 study notes across 777 chapters — written for the reader rather than the scholar.

faq.q: Does it work for a men's group?
faq.a: Well, because everyone is reading the identical translation and can see the same colors on the same page. Groups order in bulk through the volume ladder on the print page, and can mix editions — a men's group that also buys the Dad's Bible or the Teen Bible for their sons is buying the same 876 pages in a different cover.

faq.q: What age is it for? Would it suit a young man?
faq.a: Any man from late teens up. The reading level is the same throughout the line — a fresh translation in clear contemporary English — so it is not outgrown. For a reader still in school, the Teen Bible and the Seventeen Bible open with pages written for that age instead.

For a hundred and twenty-five years red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and until now those words were printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

faq.q: Can I read it before I buy it?
faq.a: Yes. Every word of the Father's Heart Bible™ is free to read online in twenty-five languages at fathersheartbible.com/read, with English and Telugu also free to listen to. Read Genesis 32 tonight and you will see the color for yourself; the print edition is for holding, giving, and handing on.
